issues.description: The problem statement requires implementing getters for each attribute (public accessors), but in the solution two getters are declared private: getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents(). This visibility mismatch will prevent students' code or automated tests from accessing these values and will likely cause tests that expect public getters to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the visibility of getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() to public in the Lecture class so they match the requirement to provide getters for each attribute. Ensure all getters are public and consistently accessible by tests and client code.
